kids_evidence: Not a children's app. Spec user: 'the person who looks after the family's devices' (an adult; GadgetNest.md:41). store/apps/GadgetNest.json primary_category = SHOPPING. No Kids or Families field.

interstitial.why: There is no AglAds.onTransition in lib/ (grep). Keep it absent. This is a short-session utility, and spec M6 says to add none until founder question 4 is answered (GadgetNest.md:134).

native.why: No content feed. The home list (lib/features/home/home_screen.dart:160-167, a ListView with one Column of the household's own devices) is the user's own small inventory. The model picker (lib/features/picker/picker_screen.dart:327-330, ListView.builder over endoflife.date releases) is a selection step inside the add-device flow, where an ad row invites mis-taps. Spec M6 says 'Never on onboarding, the picker, device detail, or Settings' (GadgetNest.md:133).

rewarded.why: Nothing honest to reward. There is no quota, premium tier or IAP: a grep of the Dart code in lib/ finds only 'Pro' inside device model names (e.g. lib/domain/device.dart:126). Reminders and the support clock are the core job.

blockers: Founder decision on the pivot, merge or retire (GadgetNest.md:9-10). The lib/ inspected is the pivot (endoflife.date) build.

Age-rating answers: there is no store/ratings/GadgetNest.json, so deliver_metadata.py:48 falls back to store/ratings/default.json, whose line 16 is "advertising": false, and passes it to Apple at deliver_metadata.py:75. This app does show banners. store-compliance should add store/ratings/GadgetNest.json with advertising: true.

agl_ads is locked in pubspec.lock to d5e5b72 (resolved-ref, line 17), which does not contain agl-manifest cb21ee5 (checked with `git merge-base --is-ancestor cb21ee5 d5e5b72`). Run `flutter pub upgrade agl_ads` before using AglNativeAd / AglAds.showRewarded.
